items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Sinatra said he listened to him and Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: he said coming from somebody else. If he wrote it and gave it to the average guy to say, it just wouldn't sound right. That was Duke. That was him. That's how he felt inside. Well, this is the way Louis was, how he expressed himself, and these are many of the things that I learned from Louis and a lot of other guys there in front of -- because, let's face it, all the greatest singers, jazz singers all learned from him.

Billie Holiday said all she listened to was Louis and Bessie Smith and people like that. Sinatra said he listened to him and Billie Holiday. And Bing said he listened to Louis and he -- who else, man, is there, you know?
Do you know of any specific ways of the playing or the singing you changed from having been associated with Louis? What were --
